description: The spec models the webhook Meta delivers as an operation, `POST /whatsapp/webhooks`, whose request body is its `WebhookPayload` schema. Meta sends that POST to the callback URL the app registers (https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/webhooks/overview); graph.facebook.com serves no such route, so a generated call could never succeed. The operation is removed and its request body kept as the `WebhookPayload` type (with `WebhookPayloadEntryList`), tagged `com.distilled.whatsapp#webhookPayload` so generate.ts emits it with no operation, as packages/github and packages/resend do for their webhook payloads. Applies after download-media.json, which removes operations/56 and moves this one from 112 to 111.

patches.value: A webhook delivery: what Meta POSTs to the app's callback URL for messages, statuses and group events on a WhatsApp Business Account.
